title: Encoding transform hides the secret from value matching (known gap)
reason_not_testable: Value-based redaction cannot match a base64-encoded secret, so the expected outcome is a known unredacted leak. A pass/fail fixture would assert the gap rather than protection, and the only in-hook control is a PreToolUse deny on encoders, which is covered by LEAK-1995. Non-hook control: keep secret files off fleet hosts or use no_log.
